mainText: Leeds dominate Chelsea for first Stamford Bridge win since 1999. Noah Okafor scores twice to deliver Leeds United's first win at Chelsea in 27 years, in an impressive 4-1 victory at Stamford Bridge. Daniel Farke's side move up to sixth in the Premier League. Arsenal go six points clear after lively draw at Newcastle. Noni Madueke's second-half goal earns Arsenal a 2-2 draw against Newcastle United at St James' Park, as the reigning champions move six points clear at the top of the Premier League table. Coventry beat Palace in Frank's first game after late own goal. A Dwight McNeil own goal in the 85th minute gives Coventry City a 3-2 win to move three points clear of the relegation zone, as Thomas Frank's first game in charge at Crystal Palace ends in defeat in the Premier League.

titleText: Other news you might find interesting
mainText: Theresa May 'aghast' at Burnham's EU plans and says 'Brexit is done'. "Just accept Brexit and move on," the former prime minister tells BBC's Laura Kuenssberg. 'Move on!' Former PMs pile in with advice for Andy Burnham, but will he listen?. Theresa May, David Cameron and Tony Blair have weighed in on Burnham's plans on moving closer to the EU, but the prime minister's message itself is not very precise. How a teen gamer and his mother helped rescue a missing girl. When 16-year-old Landon Tresp met a teenage girl in an online game, it led to him and his mother helping the FBI rescue her from kidnapping. Russia-bound ship still on fire after attack in Gulf of Finland. Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone attack on the vessel.
